dedupe_keys.name: industry 4 0 production line system and its digital twin under cyber attack swinburne

description: This dataset holds sensor readings from a real Industry 4.0 production line and from its digital twin, recorded during normal operation and during denial-of-service attacks. The IEEE DataPort page says the line has four modular stations (pick and place, assembly, muscle compressing and sorting) controlled by a Siemens PLC; the attack was launched on the PLC to delay responses and raise cycle time, and each row is labelled "Normal" or "Abnormal"; Dataset A has 62 data points per sample and Dataset B 58, stored as CSV. It was submitted by Lei Shi of Swinburne and last updated on 16 July 2023. DataCite gives the licence as CC BY 4.0, but the page marks it a Standard Dataset, so the files need an IEEE DataPort subscription (US$40 a month, free for IEEE Society members). Coverage is one laboratory production line. Caveats: only one attack type is covered, and file sizes and the recording period are not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives paired physical and digital twin signals under attack, to test anomaly detection and to calibrate how a PLC attack stretches production cycle times. Related catalogue records include the ICS-ADD smart industry testbed data and the ICS SCADA cyber kit testbed traffic.
